shards.title: Single package mutation owner with incremental verified batches
shards.purpose: Sole writer for approved package manifest/export handoffs, shared cohort and root scripts, package-manager-generated lockfile, and coordinated generated release metadata. The five packaging evidence shards reserve all 30 debt identities exactly once; their reservation is for investigation, with mutation delegated here.
shards.target_scope: Incremental integration of legal component/manifest handoffs into one package graph. Each accepted batch can land and receive focused validation independently; completion of the whole cohort remains a later barrier.
prerequisites: For the first batch only: at least one complete field-level handoff from packaging-cli-evidence, packaging-runtime-evidence, packaging-server-evidence, packaging-toolkit-evidence or packaging-docs-evidence; exact reconciled baseline and legal route for every file touched by that batch

For each affected batch only: actual required component seam and accepted upstream commit plus reviewed provenance transaction if its route depends on adoption; an unrelated pending lane does not block a lawful batch
For generated metadata batches: docs-generated-changelogs owning-generator route, approved inputs and exclusive release-generator resource ownership
For final closure only: all five package evidence shards and their actual required component/upstream/provenance handoffs are integrated; all four docs shards have lawful dispositions
handoffs: package.json -> exclusively reserve root script/dependency edits here
pnpm-lock.yaml -> this owner alone invokes package-manager generation in the integration checkout; no hand-editing and no concurrent lockfile writers
All 30 package.json identities reserved by packaging evidence shards -> this owner applies reviewed field patches sequentially
Shared exports/cohort definitions -> this owner discovers and records exact paths before mutation; no wildcard ownership expansion
FORK-DIVERGENCE.md -> separate ledger integration owner for exact same-PR dispositions; serialize commit assembly with that owner
Generated CHANGELOG.md identities reserved by docs-generated-changelogs -> owning generator/upstream path only; generation is serialized here and reviewed by that shard
verification: For each batch: verify its exact input SHA, legal-route evidence, accepted source/interface dependencies and per-file full-PR/cumulative deltas; apply fields once, generate lockfile once for the combined ready batch, run affected package build/packed-export/resolution tests and record resulting SHA plus invalidated downstream evidence.
For later batches: revalidate changed dependency closure and any earlier evidence they invalidate; do not repeatedly run every acceptance suite absent a material change.

For final closure: prove ESM/CJS/browser/Node/workerd/type closure where supported, singleton identity, no hidden governed edges, one coherent selected cohort including app-tools-extensions and exact stable sidecars, and no stale mixed aliases.

A focused batch pass establishes only the recorded package/source scope. Source candidate qualification, real ERP/Tractor/update acceptance, publication and exact published-byte proof remain separate downstream gates. No early version selection or publishing to demonstrate incremental progress.
shards.stop_condition: Final integration completes only after all actual required handoffs and legal upstream/provenance dependencies are incorporated and whole-cohort closure passes. A blocked batch stays explicit while independent lawful batches continue. Shared-file contention, generator ownership ambiguity or unproved cap compliance stops the affected mutation.

notes: Planning artifact only; no implementation, upstream submission, git/br mutation or release is authorized. Initial input is the assigned docs-ownership (47) and packaging (30) rows of um-zero-20260909/debt-inventory.json; neither lane has recorded import-edge rows. Reconcile new evidence without silently reallocating other lanes.

files is the unique debt-identity partition, not blanket write permission: four docs shards own 47 route/generator investigations; five read-only packaging evidence shards own 30 manifest investigations; packaging-integration has no duplicate files reservation and is the sole package mutation owner.

All nine identity shards can start route discovery independently. Their empty prerequisites apply to discovery only. Remediation is conditional on that identity's legal route and actual native seam; legal means genuine fork ownership for additions, accepted upstream source, existing extension point or a compliant capped patch.

Audited identity and unchanged canonical packages scope survive renames and generated rewrites. The full eventual combined PR includes PR49 and later edits; a new shard/worktree never refreshes the cap. Preserve audited base eded841256a7cffdaa622e3889fc83407debd3e4 and reviewed provenance rules.

Packaging integration is a ready-handoff queue rather than an all-components launch barrier: independent evidence arrives in parallel, sole-owner mutations and lockfile generation occur in bounded batches, and only final cohort closure waits for every actual required component/upstream/provenance dependency.

Changelogs are generated identities. Their shard audits and verifies provenance/output; only the owning changeset/release generator or accepted upstream incorporation produces changes, under one coordinated mutation owner. Generator output does not waive the 20-line cap.

Exact destinations, shared route configuration paths, root cohort paths and generator input paths are deliberately discovery outputs. Before mutation, name and reserve each concrete path and preserve other owners' edits; inferred fork-owner names or pending proposals are not authority.

No source qualification substitutes for complete release qualification or published-byte acceptance. Keep shared consumer acceptance drivers serialized unless their supported environments are genuinely isolated; this partition adds no application config or navigation shims.
